claims.claim: The paper proposes three verification boundaries: claim, run, and update.
The current claim path audits in-range markers, records bound/unbound segments, and rewrites a narrow class of unbound deterministic diagnosis assertions.
Terminal states are protected by owner leases, monotonic fencing tokens, and atomic commits.

The update library implements candidate freeze/sandbox, a four-case routing paired runner, signed envelope contracts, and atomic Git-ref promotion; sealed evaluation and independent approval remain requirements.
The deterministic adjacent-policy audit passed 40 of 40 cases.

notes: Round-1 reviewer overclaim findings were corrected by reframing the paper as a reference architecture plus partial implementation case study.
